## OperationDescriptor.inputJsonSchema property

The draft-7 JSON Schema of the input's wire values: exactly `z.toJSONSchema(input.wire, { target: 'draft-7' })`<!-- -->, computed when the contract is generated.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly inputJsonSchema?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
```

## Remarks

It describes WIRE values, not SDK values, and is always present on generated descriptors. It exists so tooling can read an operation's input schema as plain data, without zod. Adapters never read or serve it: they always derive their schemas from `input.wire`<!-- -->, which stays the single source of truth (phases/13 D9).
